svg.title: Uno R3 10 kohm NTC Thermistor Divider

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: R1 and RT1 form a ratiometric divider across the Uno supply. The wiring assumes a two-lead NTC with no polarity.

g.desc: R1 and RT1 form a ratiometric divider across the Uno supply. The wiring assumes a two-lead NTC with no polarity.

g.text: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks cover the intended topology; sensor calibration and physical readings are unverified.

g.desc: KiCad ERC and exact-net checks cover the intended topology; sensor calibration and physical readings are unverified.

g.text: Use 10 kohm fixed resistor from Uno 5 V to A0 and the 10 kohm NTC from A0 to GND.

g.desc: Use 10 kohm fixed resistor from Uno 5 V to A0 and the 10 kohm NTC from A0 to GND.

g.text: Junction voltage falls as this NTC warms. Use the exact part Beta value in the temperature equation.

g.desc: Junction voltage falls as this NTC warms. Use the exact part Beta value in the temperature equation.
